```plato

    // The branch of CreateFromRotationMatrix taken when X is the largest component.
    QuaternionFromLargestX(m: Matrix4x4): Quaternion {
        var s = (1.0 + m.Row1.X - m.Row2.Y - m.Row3.Z).Sqrt;
        var invS = 0.5 / s;
        return (0.5 * s,
                (m.Row1.Y + m.Row2.X) * invS,
                (m.Row1.Z + m.Row3.X) * invS,
                (m.Row2.Z - m.Row3.Y) * invS);
    }
```
